svg.title: low poly fete poster
svg.text: Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick
Live folk music from The Muddy Boots
In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund
Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.

g.data-flaw: The extruded title's second line is never detected, so the whole title is set on one line.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: detection that ignores the 3D extrusion would find VILLAGE FETE as its own band.
